summary: Iteration 70 — Insurance Claims 4 refinements verified PASS via backend pytest (3/3) + browser DOM inspection (ryan@ryan.com, 390x844). Backend: (a) GET /api/insurance-claims/summary now returns denied_claims=0 + open_tasks=1 alongside pre-existing keys, both ints. (b) _compute_progress clamp confirmed: created a non-final 'Submitted' test claim with a warning-prone tool (no serial/model/cost/purchase_date), drove insurer + claim# + items + evidence + report → backend _progress.percent stayed <100; moved to 'Paid' (final) → backend percent equals the recomputed raw value (no clamp engaged). Frontend: (1) Dashboard Summary tab renders DENIED CLAIMS (0) + TASKS TO COMPLETE (1) rows in order between Closed Claims and Archived Claims. (2) Claim Detail header: Status: label = 13px/800, status value retains state color (success/danger/etc via STATUS_COLORS), 'Tasks to Complete' link text = 13px/800 — fontSize + fontWeight match identically. (3) Details tab SectionHeads: 'CLAIM DETAILS', 'DESCRIPTION', 'INCIDENT NOTES' all render 12px / 900 / rgb(255,106,0) — pixel-identical styling. (4) Tab bar, search, FAB, claim list still render — no regressions. RCA: while testing I hit a pre-existing crash on the Claim Detail page (statusColor calculation at [id].tsx:177 read claim.status without optional chaining — fires BEFORE the loading/!claim early return at line 273). Fixed with `claim?.status` and restarted expo; page now renders correctly. This crash was introduced by the new statusColor variable added for refinement (1); without the fix the entire claim detail page is broken on first load. Reporting as bug-fixed.

rca_of_issue: Pre-render null-deref crash in ClaimDetail: refinement (1) added `const statusColor = STATUS_COLORS[claim.status] || c.accent;` at line 177, ABOVE the `if (loading || !claim) return …` early return at line 273. Because hooks (and any code before the return) execute on EVERY render including the initial load when claim===null, the very first render crashed on null.status. Reproduction: navigate to /insurance-claims/{any-id} cold — page blanks and shows 'Uncaught Error: Cannot read properties of null (reading status)'. Mitigation: optional-chain to `claim?.status` (now `STATUS_COLORS[undefined]` returns undefined and the `|| c.accent` fallback kicks in). Long-term fix: move all claim-derived constants below the loading guard so they never see null. Fixed in this iteration.
